13  Exploring parameter effects

  • Show All Code
  • Hide All Code

Start from saved fits and examine explicit changes to model parameters. Each sweep holds the remaining values fixed, simulates the same study lists, and saves responses and comparisons. This is a mechanism check; it performs no refitting.

13.1 Parameters and setup

1 — Configure baselines and parameter interventions 
# Working directory (None discovers the enclosing Git project).
project_root = None


# Observations and work-unit selection
data_path = "data/Dupertuys2026.h5"

# Saved model fits
fit_paths = {
    "CMR": "data/fits/Dupertuys2026_CMR_demo.json",
    "eCMR_source_only": "data/fits/Dupertuys2026_eCMR_source_only.json",
    "eCMR_broad": "data/fits/Dupertuys2026_eCMR_broad.json",
}
model_labels = {
    "CMR": "CMR",
    "eCMR_source_only": "Source-only eCMR",
    "eCMR_broad": "Broader eCMR",
}

# Controlled interventions

    "CMR_encoding": {

# Numerical precision

# Artifact formats and exact local provenance

provenance_source_paths = []

# Example: {"semantic_off": {"fit": "CMR", "overrides": {"semantic_scale": 0.0}}}

3 — Import packages 
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from tabulate import tabulate

import jaxcmr
from jaxcmr import repetition
from jaxcmr.helpers import (
    find_project_root,
    resolve_project_path,
    generate_trial_mask,
    import_from_string,
    load_data,
    save_dict_to_hdf5,
    save_figure,
)
from jaxcmr.simulation import parameter_shifted_simulate_h5_from_h5, simulate_h5_from_h5

from jaxcmr.provenance import capture_notebook
4 — Define feature loading and model construction 
def load_features(spec):
    semantic = np.load(resolve_project_path(spec["embedding_path"], root_path)) if spec.get("embedding_path") else None
    categorical = (
        np.load(resolve_project_path(spec["emotion_feature_path"], root_path))[
            :,
            int(spec.get("feature_column", 6)) : int(spec.get("feature_column", 6)) + 1,
        ]
        if spec.get("emotion_feature_path")
        else None
    )
    if spec.get("concat_features", False):
        return np.concatenate([categorical, semantic], axis=1)
    return categorical if categorical is not None else semantic


def construct_model(spec):
    return import_from_string(spec["model_factory"])(
        **{name: import_from_string(path) for name, path in spec["components"].items()}
    )

5a — Capture parameters, inputs and exact local source 
provenance = capture_notebook(
    {name: globals()[name] for name in ['project_root', 'analysis_trial_query', 'comparison_analysis_configs', 'confidence_level', 'data_path', 'enable_x64', 'experiment_count', 'figure_dir', 'figure_formats', 'figure_size', 'figure_str', 'filter_repeated_recalls', 'fit_paths', 'max_subjects', 'model_labels', 'notebook_source', 'output_dir', 'parameter_interventions', 'parameter_sweeps', 'plot_seed', 'provenance_dir', 'provenance_source_paths', 'redo_figures', 'simulation_seed', 'single_analysis_configs', 'subject_indices', 'trial_query']},
    resolve_project_path(provenance_dir, root_path) if provenance_dir is not None else resolve_project_path(output_dir, root_path) / "provenance",

13.2 Load the baseline fits

6 — Load baseline fits and select their observations 
fit_paths = {name: resolve_project_path(path, root_path) for name, path in fit_paths.items()}
records = {name: json.loads(path.read_text()) for name, path in fit_paths.items()}
if not records:
    raise ValueError("Supply at least one saved fit.")
display_labels = {
    name: model_labels.get(name, record.get("label", name))
    for name, record in records.items()
}
selections = {}
for name, record in records.items():
    if record.get("data_sha256", data_sha256) != data_sha256:
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: the fit refers to a different observation file.")
    if trial_query is None and "selected_trial_indices" in record:
        mask = (
            jnp.zeros(len(subjects), dtype=bool)
            .at[jnp.asarray(record["selected_trial_indices"], dtype=int)]
            .set(True)
        )
    else:
        mask = generate_trial_mask(
            data,
            trial_query
            if trial_query is not None
            else record.get("trial_query", record.get("data_query")),
        )
    subject_ids = np.unique(subjects)
    if max_subjects:
        subject_ids = subject_ids[:max_subjects]
    if subject_indices:
        subject_ids = subject_ids[np.asarray(subject_indices, dtype=int)]
    mask &= jnp.isin(data["subject"].ravel(), subject_ids)
    if not record.get("pooled", record["fits"]["subject"] == [-1]):
        mask &= jnp.isin(
            data["subject"].ravel(), jnp.asarray(record["fits"]["subject"])
        )
    if not bool(mask.any()):
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: no observations match the selected work unit.")
    selections[name] = mask
    print(display_labels[name], "—", int(mask.sum()), "lists; fit:", fit_paths[name])

13.3 Simulate controlled changes

7 — Prepare sweeps and simultaneous interventions 
sweep_inputs = {}
base_figure_dir = resolve_project_path(figure_dir, root_path) if figure_dir is not None else output_dir
if set(parameter_sweeps) & set(parameter_interventions):
    raise ValueError("Sweep and intervention names must be distinct")
specifications = {}
for name, sweep in parameter_sweeps.items():
    values = sweep["values"]
    if not values or len(set(values)) != len(values):
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: supply distinct parameter values")
    specifications[name] = {
        "fit": sweep["fit"],
        "cases": [{"label": str(value), "stem": f"{sweep['parameter']}_{value}",
                   "overrides": {sweep["parameter"]: value}} for value in values],
    }
for name, intervention in parameter_interventions.items():
    if not intervention["overrides"]:
        raise ValueError(f"{name}: supply at least one parameter override")
    specifications[name] = {
        "fit": intervention["fit"],
        "cases": [{"label": intervention.get("label", name), "stem": "intervention",
                   "overrides": intervention["overrides"]}],
    }
for name, specification in specifications.items():
    record = records[specification["fit"]]
    selection = selections[specification["fit"]]
    params = {key: jnp.asarray(values) for key, values in record["fits"].items()}
    if record.get("pooled", record["fits"]["subject"] == [-1]):
        ids = jnp.unique(data["subject"].ravel()[selection])
        params = {key: jnp.repeat(value, len(ids)) for key, value in params.items() if key != "subject"}
        params["subject"] = ids
    fixed = record.get("fit_configuration", {}).get("parameters", {}).get("fixed", record["fixed"])
    for key, value in fixed.items():
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            params[key] = params[key].astype(bool)
    for case in specification["cases"]:
        for key in case["overrides"]:
            if key not in params or key == "subject":
                raise ValueError(f"{name}: unknown or invalid parameter {key}")
    sweep_inputs[name] = dict(fit_name=specification["fit"], parameters=params,
                             trial_mask=selection, cases=specification["cases"])
    print(name, "baseline:", specification["fit"], "interventions:", specification["cases"])
CMR_encoding baseline: CMR interventions: [{'label': '0.2', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.2', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.2}}, {'label': '0.5', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.5', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.5}}, {'label': '0.8', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.8', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.8}}]
eCMR_source_only_encoding baseline: eCMR_source_only interventions: [{'label': '0.2', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.2', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.2}}, {'label': '0.5', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.5', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.5}}, {'label': '0.8', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.8', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.8}}]
eCMR_broad_encoding baseline: eCMR_broad interventions: [{'label': '0.2', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.2', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.2}}, {'label': '0.5', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.5', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.5}}, {'label': '0.8', 'stem': 'encoding_drift_rate_0.8', 'overrides': {'encoding_drift_rate': 0.8}}]
temporal_emotional_modulation baseline: eCMR_broad interventions: [{'label': 'False', 'stem': 'phi_emot_modulates_temporal_False', 'overrides': {'phi_emot_modulates_temporal': False}}, {'label': 'True', 'stem': 'phi_emot_modulates_temporal_True', 'overrides': {'phi_emot_modulates_temporal': True}}]
8 — Simulate and save each baseline and intervention 
all_shifted_paths = {}
for sweep_name, prepared in sweep_inputs.items():
    model_name = prepared["fit_name"]
    fit_record = records[model_name]
    model_factory = construct_model(fit_record)
    features = load_features(fit_record)
    selected_trials = prepared["trial_mask"]
    paths = {}
    cases = [{"label": "Fitted baseline", "stem": "baseline", "overrides": {}}] + prepared["cases"]
    for case in cases:
        params = dict(prepared["parameters"])
        for key, value in case["overrides"].items():
            params[key] = jnp.full_like(params[key], value)
        simulated = simulate_h5_from_h5(
            model_factory, data, features, params, selected_trials,
            experiment_count=experiment_count,
            rng=jax.random.PRNGKey(simulation_seed),
            simulate_trial_fn=import_from_string(fit_record["simulation_function"]),
        )
        path = output_dir / sweep_name / (case["stem"] + ".h5")
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        save_dict_to_hdf5(simulated, str(path))
        metadata = {
            "baseline_fit_sha256": hashlib.sha256(fit_paths[model_name].read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            "baseline_fits": fit_record["fits"],
            "applied_parameters": {key: np.asarray(value).tolist() for key, value in params.items()},
            "parameter_overrides": case["overrides"],
            "data_sha256": data_sha256,
            "selected_trial_indices": np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(selected_trials)).tolist(),
            "model_factory": fit_record["model_factory"], "components": fit_record["components"],
            "simulation_function": fit_record["simulation_function"],
            "feature_sha256": hashlib.sha256(features.tobytes()).hexdigest() if features is not None else None,
            "seed": simulation_seed, "experiment_count": experiment_count,
            "jaxcmr_version": jaxcmr.__version__, "jax_version": jax.__version__,
            "jax_enable_x64": enable_x64, "provenance": provenance,
        }
        path.with_suffix(".json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2) + "\n")
        paths[case["label"]] = str(path)
    all_shifted_paths[sweep_name] = paths
9 — Prepare comparisons of saved sweep results 
comparison_groups = []
observed = dict(data)
if filter_repeated_recalls:
    observed["recalls"] = repetition.filter_repeated_recalls(observed["recalls"])
for sweep_name, paths in all_shifted_paths.items():
    sweep_figure_dir = base_figure_dir / sweep_name
    sweep_figure_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not redo_figures:
        continue
    response_paths = [None, *paths.values()]  # None selects the observed responses.
    curve_labels = ["Observed", *paths.keys()]
    shared_settings = {
        "trial_mask": sweep_inputs[sweep_name]["trial_mask"],
        "figure_dir": sweep_figure_dir,
    }
    comparison_groups.append(
        {
            **shared_settings,
            "analyses": comparison_analysis_configs,
            "paths": response_paths,
            "labels": curve_labels,
            "suffix": "",
        }
    )
    for dataset_index, (path, label) in enumerate(zip(response_paths, curve_labels)):
        comparison_groups.append(
            {
                **shared_settings,
                "analyses": single_analysis_configs,
                "paths": [path],
                "labels": [label],
                "suffix": f"_single_{dataset_index}",
            }
        )
10 — Load one comparison at a time and plot its benchmarks 
for group in comparison_groups:
    analysis_configs = group["analyses"]
    if not analysis_configs:
        continue
    panel_data = []
    for path in group["paths"]:
        dataset = observed if path is None else load_data(path)
        if path is not None and filter_repeated_recalls:
            dataset["recalls"] = repetition.filter_repeated_recalls(dataset["recalls"])
        panel_data.append(dataset)
    curve_labels = group["labels"]
    figure_suffix = group["suffix"]
    figure_dir = group["figure_dir"]
    comparison_mask = group["trial_mask"]
    for analysis_index, analysis_config in enumerate(analysis_configs):
        plotter = import_from_string(analysis_config["target"])
        masks = [
            generate_trial_mask(
                dataset, analysis_config.get("trial_query", analysis_trial_query)
            )
            for dataset in panel_data
        ]
        masks = [
            trial_mask & comparison_mask if dataset is observed else trial_mask
            for dataset, trial_mask in zip(panel_data, masks)
        ]
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=analysis_config.get("figsize", figure_size))
        plot_options = {
            "labels": analysis_config.get("labels", curve_labels),
            "contrast_name": analysis_config.get("contrast_name", "Responses"),
            "confidence_level": confidence_level,
            "axis": ax,
            **analysis_config.get("kwargs", {}),
        }
        if analysis_config.get("color_cycle") is not None:
            plot_options["color_cycle"] = analysis_config["color_cycle"]
        plotter(panel_data, masks, **plot_options)
        ax.set_title(analysis_config.get("title", plotter.__name__))
        if analysis_config.get("ylim") is not None:
            ax.set_ylim(analysis_config["ylim"])
        suffix = (
            analysis_config.get("figure_suffix", plotter.__name__.removeprefix("plot_"))
            + figure_suffix
        )
        if (
            sum(
                other["target"] == analysis_config["target"]
                for other in analysis_configs
            )
            > 1
            and "figure_suffix" not in analysis_config
        ):
            suffix += f"_{analysis_index + 1}"
        save_figure(str(figure_dir), figure_str, suffix=suffix, formats=figure_formats)
